key_insight: All five first-order Raman phonon modes of paramagnetic MnTe₂ were identified, including a previously unresolved T_g mode near 107 cm⁻¹.
engineering_relevance: The complete Raman-mode assignment provides a reference for spectroscopic characterization and validation of computational models of MnTe₂.
method: Polarization-, excitation-, and temperature-dependent Raman measurements
Density functional theory calculations of phonons and magnetic configurations
Group-theory-guided assignment of A_g, E_g, and three T_g modes
evidence_signal: DFT reproduced the observed Raman spectrum, supporting the assignment of a T_g mode only 1.5 cm⁻¹ above E_g; cooling just below T_N ≈ 90 K left phonon properties largely unchanged.
watch_item: Near-infrared absorption is only a proposed explanation for the anomalous angular intensity dependence of the 183 cm⁻¹ T_g mode.
paper_title: Paramagnetic phase of MnTe$_2$: complete one phonon Raman spectrum
